problems_encountered.description: Docker 18.09.0 + runc 1.1.3 containers cannot start: OCI runtime start failed: listen unixgram notify.sock: bind: invalid argument. Docker Hub also unreachable.
problems_encountered.root_cause: Docker 18.09 + runc 1.1.3 notify socket compatibility bug on openEuler aarch64 kernel
problems_encountered.solution: Used host-native openEuler 22.03 LTS SP3 (host IS base OS). Dependencies installed via dnf from scratch.

problems_encountered.description: SVE2-256 compiled binaries crash on Kunpeng 920 with Illegal instruction
problems_encountered.root_cause: Kunpeng 920 does not support SVE2 instructions. Docs target Kunpeng 950 which has full SVE2 support.
problems_encountered.solution: Compiled without SVE2-256 for functional testing (175/175 tests pass). Verified SVE2-256 compilation correctness via objdump nmatch detection.
